# Marley & Moose

> > A parenting blog focused on child development, open-ended play, sustainable parenting, and screen-free activities for young children.

Marley & Moose provides evidence-based parenting guidance drawing from Montessori principles, developmental psychology, and eco-conscious living. The blog covers topics from pregnancy through early childhood, emphasizing play-based learning, sustainable toy choices, and outdoor family activities.

## Key Topics

- Open-ended play
- Child development
- Montessori education
- Screen time management
- Sustainable parenting
- Eco-friendly toys
- Toddler activities
- Early childhood development
- Educational toys
- Independent play
- STEM learning
- Outdoor family activities
- Developmental milestones
- Pregnancy wellness
- Screen-free parenting

## Child Development & Play

- [Understanding and Encouraging Open-Ended Play for Young Children](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/understanding-and-encouraging-open-ended-play-for-young-children): Guide to open-ended play with Montessori insights and toy recommendations
- [How To Get Your Toddler to Play Independently Without Screens](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/how-to-get-your-toddler-to-play-independently-without-screens): Screen-free strategies for promoting toddler independent play
- [Screen Time and Child Development](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/screen-time-and-child-development): Research-based guide on screen time effects on child development
- [6 Creative Games To Play With Simple Wooden Blocks](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/creative-games-to-play-with-simple-wooden-blocks): Six creative wooden block games for motor skills and learning
- [Sustainable Open-Ended Play Activities for Toddlers](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/sustainable-open-ended-play-activities-for-toddlers): Eco-friendly open-ended play activities for toddler development
- [Getting started with video games for kids](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/video-games-for-kids): Parent guide to video game consoles and child development impacts

## Sustainable & Eco-Friendly Parenting

- [Eco-Friendly Toys: A Parent's Guide to Greener Living](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/eco-friendly-toys-a-parents-guide-to-greener-living): Parent guide to eco-friendly toys with GOTS and CPSC standards
- [7 Thoughtful Yet Practical Eco-Friendly Shower Gifts](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/7-eco-friendly-baby-shower-gifts): Seven sustainable baby shower gift ideas with organic materials
- [Developmentally Appropriate Gift Guide for Toddlers](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/developmentally-appropriate-gift-guide-for-toddlers): Toddler gift guide focused on developmental milestones and STEM toys

## Family Activities & Outdoor Adventures

- [9 Tips to Make Hiking with Toddlers Safe and Fun!](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/hiking-with-toddlers): Trail-tested hiking tips and gear guide for toddlers and families
- [National Parks Junior Ranger Program](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/national-parks-junior-ranger-program): Guide to National Park Service Junior Ranger Program for families
- [Keep Kids Reading All Summer: Why It Matters & Where to Find Local Programs](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/keep-kids-reading-all-summer-why-it-matters-where-to-find-local-programs): Summer reading programs guide to prevent summer slide in literacy

## Pregnancy & Maternal Health

- [Health and Wellness During Pregnancy Tips](https://blog.marleyandmoose.com/health-wellness-during-pregnancy-tips): Essential pregnancy health and wellness tips for maternal care
